serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Y-yeah, there was that one hobo here. He found that bloody patch, but that’s all. He doesn’t know much about this.
#Policewoman.Face.annoyed
Policewoman: Fucking great.
Policewoman: Where is he now?
You: I don’t know…
Policewoman: What’s his name, where he lives. Do you know any of these things?
You: No, sorry.
Policewoman: Do you know anything about that guy?
You: I’m really sorry, but I do not. I met him only a few times, so he probably lives somewhere in the area.
Policewoman: …
Policewoman: Besides that guy, who else knows about this?
You: No one! I think…
#Policewoman.Face.normal
